expectation_basis: Finite expectations independently follow entry read permissions, signed definedness, modulo unsigned arithmetic, exact written postcondition and retained exit ownership. ERROR is expected only for reading undefined cells or no readable cell, with explicit diagnostic guard; Fulminate reports these rejected executions as FAIL. Null pointer under emp is a legal entry, and subsequent dereference must be rejected.

excluded_inputs.reason: Entry requires old<INT_MAX. Undefined-storage variants carry no initialized old value and are tested using uninitialized C locals, not fabricated ghosts.

cn_original_slf0_incr.broken.scope: INT_MAX initialized cell is permitted by QCP undef_data_at, which forgets initialization/value information; original body exhibits signed overflow. Complements native refusal to read from an undefined-cell precondition. Not an MSan test of an uninitialized allocation.
